verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's homepage claims first-party agents that 'monitor your product continuously' and proactively surface insights, which is autonomous background behavior. But this is a single marketing line with no docs on how a user configures, schedules, or triggers such automations or what actions they can take. Warehouse sync and the MCP server are related but not user-defined background automations. Missing for 10: documented setup/configuration of automations, user-defined triggers or recurring schedules, the actions automations can take, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Agents monitor your product continuously, surface insights before you think to ask, and tell your team exactly what to do next.
